approval.meaning: No remaining static compatibility blocker found after the incoming merge, fixture correction and separately pinned updated datasets checkout. The active integration run has no outcome asserted by this review.

datasets.scope: All 51 listed afad execution files match immutable afad Git objects and the root integration before manifest. The historical 29-file scope still matches f471 objects, preserved f471 checkout and afad objects. Differences/additions outside those 29 are explicitly retained per row; neither whole-datasets nor runtime/toolchain equivalence is asserted.

execution_dependency_blocker_and_resolut.initial_finding: Old f471 execution lacks intent_action_checkpoint_384.py, while incoming packaging/readiness tests require it. Equality of the old 29-file dependency scope cannot establish availability or compatibility for this new dependency.
execution_dependency_blocker_and_resolut.resolution: Root created a separate clean locked afad datasets worktree and froze an integration runner that executes that matching parent pin with 51 explicit datasets producer files. Historical qualification-01/02 f471 checkout and reference-only 5723 records remain unchanged.

historical_attempts.observed_failure: Previous fixture indexed a None page for the original-source read at budget 2048. Its exact budget/assertion correction is retained in independent-review-02.json.
The fixture mocked load_descriptor with an object lacking schema, and router receipt version dispatch raised KeyError: schema. Production load_descriptor validates a complete closed descriptor.

findings.finding: New owner_controlled defaults False. Source collector _read(... private=True) keeps owner custody, 0600-style privacy, no-follow, single-link, byte bounds and FD/named-path identity checks. The distinct event-log call opts into owner_controlled=True only under the previously checked owner-private attempt directory and still forbids other write permissions. _identity shape remains unchanged.

Only closed evidence-stage enum values from the specified unavailable failure observation survive comparison. Exception text, unknown stages and inconsistent status/reason combinations are omitted. No proof, completion, usage or token claim is added.

Preparation reads the bounded complete public instruction and uses the existing Harbor newline normalization before optional readiness screening; the file is not rewritten. The readiness receipt is added to preparation metadata and does not change source-view profile selection or grants.

Selection, complete-input grammar scope and explicit local checkpoint load eligibility are separate. Unselected/archive-only selection does not load container paths on the host. No embeddings/numerical inference, grammar splitting, paraphrase or proof is claimed; continuation remains allowed when optional scope/loading is unavailable. raw_instruction_preserved refers to the supplied normalized instruction text, not an additional byte-exact-original-file assertion.

Packaging uses the same Intent-specific checkpoint owner as inference rather than the unrelated strict structured loader. Checkpoint bytes remain SHA-pinned and are not rewritten. The compatibility helper permits only its exact reviewed stderr tree-pin transition; numerical weights, target schema and all other checkpoint implementation fields remain subject to the helper strict checks.

historical_26_source_binding_deltas_afte.reason: Incoming origin/main change in merged baseline

integration_observation.outcome: No pass/fail result asserted for the active merged integration run. Its commands.json is mutable root-owned evidence until completion; this review binds the retained before manifest only.

legacy_fixture_correction.assessment: This restores the production loader guarantee in the mock and preserves strict product schema dispatch; no product validation was weakened.
legacy_fixture_correction.change: Add schema=client.DESCRIPTOR_SCHEMA to the existing mocked legacy descriptor.

limits: Discovery covers only the existing task-admitted bounded population: up to 64 canonical source paths and the existing one-MiB source bound. It is not complete repository inventory export or a whole-filesystem minified state.

Discovery is for the baseline admission. A changed workspace invalidates baseline discovery; working-candidate read/context generation is separate and does not admit new paths or refresh accepted formal evidence.
This transport does not intercept ordinary cat/grep/tool reads, make compact text executable, implement a whole-codebase toggle, or change the already implemented host-only mapped edit workflow.

Legacy audit schemas remain structurally supported, but guidance digests are checked against the matching software guidance implementation; historical archives require their source revision and are not granted cross-version replay by this static review.

The isolated CLI fixture authors the descriptor UID loader seam under one UID. It exercises the real socket/registered descendant path when run, but does not by itself qualify a separate owner/worker filesystem boundary.

Byte and row accounting is not tokenizer usage, unique source coverage, model comprehension, semantic equivalence, native task correctness or total TerminalBench savings. No provider/model/solver outcome is established.

The integrated readiness/packaging producer bindings include reused model runtime sources, but this static review does not load decoder weights, run model inference, train/distill, authenticate reconstruction quality, or attest all optional runtime dependencies.
method: Read-only source/diff and test-fixture compatibility review, AST parsing without product imports, actual Git-object and checkout byte comparisons, and observation of retained root-owned failed attempts and active integration before manifest. Reviewer executed no tests, collection, product/CLI/model/provider/solver/training/Docker or publication.

reviewer.authorship_boundary: Reviewer authored worker_source_client.py for this phase. Consumer, lifecycle, router, collector, tests and runner review is independent of their authorship; the client itself is not claimed as independently authored/reviewed by this reviewer. Root separately reviewed the client diff.

source_binding_scope: Current reviewed 26 paths plus 12 relevant merged consumer/test/interface/runner paths against immutable 8a baseline and active before manifest where present. Baseline equality is an observation at review time, not whole-runtime equivalence or future working-copy equality.
